activeSlice.scope: Restore fail-closed Hunter V1/V2 shadow control comparability without changing rollout thresholds: require productive V1 control work for every paired observation and screen operational cohorts so no-op controls cannot enter cost or latency gate math.
successCriteria: Every Hunter V1 control result reports the number of recommendations produced by the real production control path.
A paired shadow observation is rejected before rollout evaluation when the V1 control produces zero recommendations.
Operational cohort construction screens Hunter-ready Brands with a read-only V1 preflight and excludes no-op controls before paired runs are assembled.
At least one persisted Brand remains mandatory; ephemeral public Brands may fill only remaining comparable cohort slots when explicitly enabled.
No invalid control observation is silently dropped after a paired run starts; any later no-op control fails closed.
The existing maxP95LatencyRatio=1.5 and maxAverageCostRatio=1.5 remain unchanged.
The existing explorationMin=0.08, explorationMax=0.20, maximumTopicShare=0.34 and maxCandidates=6 remain unchanged.
Corrected 3x3 pre-gate passes before any 30-pair full gate.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
